Today, when the matter is taken up for hearing, there was no representation on behalf of the petitioner, though the matter is listed under the caption for dismissal.
Despite giving sufficient opportunity, the petitioner has not appeared before this Court and is not interested to prosecute the writ petition.
Therefore, the Writ Petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
No costs.

Consequently,
the connected miscellaneous petitions are also closed.
3. In case, the petitioner filed a restoration petition, he shall pay a sum of Rs.1 Lakh to the credit of The Chief Justice Relief Fund.
Unless the said amount is paid, the Registry shall not taken the petition on file.
